breakdown.description: Inviscid (zero viscosity) is incompatible with diffusion flame which relies on viscous/diffusive transport. The simulation must use sutherland transport, not zero viscosity.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The ground truth explicitly states to use the Sutherland transport model and *not* set viscosity to zero because a diffusion flame requires viscous transport. The agent correctly included the Sutherland model but then added a separate "Viscosity" section that directly repeated the user's original error, instructing to "Set the dynamic viscosity to 0 everywhere to represent an inviscid flame configuration."
